patient_identity.statement: Patient 6 is male and six years old in Table 1.

genotype.statement: Patient 6 carries c.3434delC / p.P1145fs; all six patient variants are explicitly heterozygous and Sanger-confirmed.

segregation.statement: All six variants were absent from both parents after trio sequencing and Sanger confirmation; maternity and paternity were confirmed as WES quality control.

phase.statement: A single heterozygous de novo allele is represented; two-allele cis/trans phase is inapplicable.

causal_confidence.statement: Authors support HIVEP2 as the neurodevelopmental disease gene using recurrent de novo variants, phenotype overlap and predicted loss of function.
limitations: Patient 6 has no direct variant-specific RNA/protein functional assay. Patient 4 missense evidence is explicitly prediction-only and not transferred to this frameshift.

phenotype_completeness.statement: All Patient 6 table cells were compared. Many packet negatives expand broad N/normal cells or absence from a positive list into specific exclusions. Bronchial hyperreactivity and detailed growth are not exhaustively encoded.
limitations: Broad domain-level negatives and unreported individual features have different evidentiary strength.

assessment.statement: Heterozygous c.3434delC / p.P1145fs agrees. The packet further specifies NM_006734.4, p.Pro1145ArgfsTer2 and GRCh38/VCF deletion normalization, which are not printed in this source.
limitations: Exact terminal residue/stop, reference version and genomic-coordinate normalization were not independently recomputed.
